description: This file contains the structure and styling for a web-based database viewer, including layout for presenting database tables and data along with interactivity via JavaScript.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the available databases from the backend.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the current database selection.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables from the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table in the database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates and displays an HTML table with data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cells with appropriate formatting for values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a clicked cell to show full content if truncated.
